description: This file defines the ChooseClassDialog class, a GUI dialog component for selecting Java classes within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment, with functionality to search and find inheriting classes.

classes.name: ChooseClassDialog
classes.description: A dialog for selecting Java classes, supporting search and double-click to select.

methods.name: findClasses
methods.description: Finds classes by name and adds inheritors to the model.

methods.name: findInheritors
methods.description: Finds classes that inherit from a given base class within a scope.

methods.name: findClass
methods.description: Finds a class by name within a module.

methods.name: getPreferredFocusedComponent
methods.description: Returns the component to focus when the dialog opens.

methods.name: createCenterPanel
methods.description: Creates the main panel of the dialog.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the selected class's qualified name.

methods.name: valueChanged
methods.description: Handles selection changes in the list, updating the OK button state and selected class name.
